{{Top|leg}}
A '''salve''' was an antibiotic healing remedy, sprayed or smeared onto burns and wounds of the skin. It was a wet, stringy, goopy jelly-like substance that exhibited a vile chemical smell, purchased in a tube or jar. It was essential for first-aid kits.

Many salves were [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] based, though natural salves such as the skin oil of a [[Ghhhk/Legends|ghhhk]] were also used.
